title: Clean vs Messy Setups
hook: Valid isn’t the same as wanted.

takeaways: Validity is method compliance. Quality is a contextual review. Keep them separate.
A / B / C are review labels, not trading signals.
VALID + C + PASS is a real combination.
remember: The goal isn’t to find ICC everywhere. The goal is to know which ICC you actually want.
